english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something excellent, great, or wonderful.
Use 正 as the casual all-purpose choice for something very good, enjoyable, or excellent.
Use 正 as the casual all-purpose evaluation for an excellent performance or a great person or thing.
For exceptional quality in casual speech, this is the all-purpose choice.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something cool, great, or excellent.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something exceptionally good or first-rate.
Use this for an enthusiastic, broadly positive reaction to food or something appealing, rather than a literal flavor description.
Use this for something amazingly good or impressive, especially in casual speech, rather than for physical beauty.
Use this when proper means excellent, high-quality, or really good rather than merely suitable.
Use this for approving of a person, performance, or thing as excellent rather than describing physical intensity.
Use colloquial 正 for something excellent, awesome, or impressively done.
Use 正 for an enthusiastic, colloquial sense of nice or wonderful.
Use this slangy word when safe means cool, great, or worthy of approval.
